text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит trains hard for the Osaka
Hai.
Despite her efforts though, her time
is not
improving.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In order to break through the wall she
faces, we
hold a scrimmage with Narita
Taishin and Biwa
Hayahide.
Unfortunately, she still doesn't
improve.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит remarks positively that
they ran a
great race, but Бива Хаяхидэ
counters, asking if
she's not upset at the
loss.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Though confused about the meaning of
that
question, Уиннинг Тикит tries to
stay eager to
work hard.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
